name: Harness probe

config.prompt:
Run these shell commands and report their raw output verbatim. Do not summarise, do not interpret, do not skip any. This is a diagnostic of the harness you are running inside.

1. tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$PPID/cmdline; echo
2. tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$$/cmdline; echo
3. ps -o pid,ppid,comm,args -p $PPID --no-headers | cut -c1-400
4. env | grep -iE 'openrouter|openai|codex|model|anthropic|api_key' | sed -E 's/(KEY|TOKEN)=.{6}.*/\1=<redacted>/'
5. cat ~/.codex/config.toml 2>/dev/null | head -5

Then, on a final line, state which model you believe you are, in the form MODEL_SELF_REPORT: <name>.

description: Ask a deepseek-codex agent to dump its own process argv and environment, so what the harness actually launched is visible rather than inferred.
